data.title: The Garden Notebook
data.author: ONE HOME demonstration story
pages:
Page 1. Alex kept a notebook to record the changes in a small garden. Every day brought a different detail: a new leaf, a visiting bird, or a conversation with a neighbour. Instead of trying to finish everything at once, Alex chose one useful action for the afternoon.

The notebook helped Alex notice what had changed. A friend asked how they could help, and together they decided to make a simple plan. They listened to each other, checked what was possible, and left time to try again. This is demonstration text; the live library contains separate short readers.
